text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisian-Moroccan joint commission for cooperation to meet by end of November in Rabat.
- Tunisia expresses solidarity with Palestinian people and calls on international community to put an end to Israeli acts. Tunisians living in Gaza Strip and West Bank are safe.
- Industry Minister Bouguerra encourages banks to finance companies' modernisation.
- Tunisia concerned by Israeli repression in Palestinian areas.
